lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Engineering, I have a small situation.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Small situations do not usually call Engineering.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: One of the panels has stopped being attached.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: It was outside when we began this conversation.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: It has begun exploring independent career options.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: There is a new light on the console.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: You would understand if you could see it.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I understand perfectly. Stop calling it a small situation.
